summary: This note is a short biography of Christa B. Allen, an American actress born November 11, 1991. It notes her childhood roles playing the younger versions of Jennifer Garner's characters in two films, and her later role on the ABC drama Revenge.
one_line: Christa B. Allen is an American actress known for youthful roles in 13 Going on 30 and Ghosts of Girlfriends Past and for Revenge.
key_facts: Christa B. Allen was born on November 11, 1991.
Christa B. Allen is an American actress.
Christa B. Allen played the younger version of Jennifer Garner's characters in 13 Going on 30 (2004).
Christa B. Allen played the younger version of Jennifer Garner's characters in Ghosts of Girlfriends Past (2009).
Christa B. Allen is known for her role as socialite Charlotte Grayson on the ABC drama series Revenge.
